scripts.build:app: npm run build:audio && npm run build:mcp && TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY="$(cat $HOME/.tauri/lane.key)" TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD="" tauri build --bundles app && scripts/sign-runtime.sh
scripts.build:audio: cd src-tauri/audio && swiftc -O -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker helper-info.plist -framework AVFoundation -framework CoreAudio -o lane-audio lane-audio.swift && swiftc -O -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker helper-info.plist -framework EventKit -o lane-calendar lane-calendar.swift && swiftc -O -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker helper-info.plist -framework Vision -framework AppKit -o lane-ocr lane-ocr.swift && swiftc -O -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker helper-info.plist -framework Contacts -o lane-contacts lane-contacts.swift && swiftc -O -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker helper-info.plist -framework AppKit -o lane-shot lane-shot.swift
scripts.build:mcp: cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/lane-mcp/Cargo.toml --target-dir src-tauri/target && mkdir -p src-tauri/mcp && cp src-tauri/target/release/lane-mcp src-tauri/mcp/lane-mcp
